card.title: Say You’re Sorry
card.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your parents arrive in ten minutes. I'd like to be able to smile at you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we'd sorted this out by text.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You sent a thumbs-up. I couldn't hear any remorse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right here. Could you give the sad face a sentence beginning with 'I'?

mechanism: A pressures for an actual apology through an approaching family visit and the inadequacy of emoji replies.
confusable: Unlike asking to improve a text message, A must pursue personal remorse without naming the underlying offense.
comparison: D03-b uses a deadline and a sentence prompt; D03-a uses the continuing possibility of tea and a corrected apology.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
